nodeNames.description: Names specifying nodes to restart partitions. Case-sensitive. If empty/omitted, partitions on all nodes are restarted.

zoneName.description: Name of the zone to restart partitions of. Without quotes, case-sensitive.

partitionIds.description: IDs of partitions to restart. If empty/omitted, all partitions will be restarted.

tableName.description: Fully-qualified name of the table to restart partitions of.
